create_notebook_session: create a Jupyter notebook session by providing the absolute path to an .ipynb file
execute_notebook_cell: execute a single cell in a notebook session by index with optional source override
get_notebook_session_status: get the status of a notebook session including kernel name and busy state
delete_notebook_session: stop and destroy a notebook session and its associated Jupyter kernel
create_notebooks_router: create a FastAPI router with notebook session CRUD endpoints protected by API key auth
